title: Daily Order Care
meta: A set routine for orders, issues and follow-ups handled for you, as a fixed starter sprint. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Daily order care, a starter sprint
overview: This is a short, fixed period of daily order handling for stores that want to see how outsourced order care feels. We agree a simple routine with you, then work through it each business day: new orders checked, problems flagged, fulfilment followed, customer questions answered and a short end of day note to you. You see exactly what we did, and we recommend what to change. Continuing monthly care is quoted separately.

faq: No. It is a fixed starter sprint with a set amount of work. If you want us to continue after it, we quote a monthly plan, based on the volume we saw in the sprint.
Which days and hours do you work?
Business days, on a schedule we agree with you at the start. We do not run nights, weekends or holiday cover in this order, unless we agree it in writing.
No. We take care of the order side of things, such as checks, follow-ups and replies. Packing and shipping stay with you, or your warehouse or supplier.
What can you decide without asking me?
Only what the routine says. Refunds, cancellations and exceptions need your approval, and we keep a list of what we hold for you each day.
